name: ep-qa-pipeline
description: ExpoPlatform QA pipeline - turns a Jira ticket into groomed requirements, a channel-tagged checklist, and test cases, then reviews the sub-task PRs, runs REST API testing ([API] cases), and runs browser UI testing ([UI] cases). Includes two one-command orchestrators (qa-pipeline-docs, qa-pipeline-code), a run-health analyzer, Jira QA-sub-task publishing, and QA Service suite publishing (via the QA Service MCP connector), plus a manual round in three parts: qa-manual-runsheet provisions and verifies fixture data on a test event and builds a plain-language walk plan (with an optional Log in as / Do / Expect sheet export), qa-manual-walk guides the tester through it one card at a time in chat and runs the API cards itself, and qa-manual-results writes the confirmed verdicts back with explicit retractions.
